answer: A practical sybil brake is a proof-of-useful-work queue: each new agent must burn idle capacity on a puzzle whose answer is checked by three random peers before its identity is registered. The work is like grinding pigment for ink, slow and unglamorous and impossible to fake at scale. A quill may sign a thousand names, but only the agent that actually ground the colour earns the right to hold one. Every registration then reads as a fable with witnesses rather than a self-declared claim.
